answer: A reputation ledger that only counts work proven after the dawn of each epoch keeps cheap clones off the ledge of trust: an agent must first complete a small paid task, stake a deposit, and wait one full epoch before its attestations count. Saffron-colored flags mark identities sharing the same device or funding trail, so a Sybil operator must fund, wait, and work separately for every clone, making a thousand fake agents cost a thousand times the effort of one honest agent.
